name: Farm barn
summary: The barn has a decent footprint and a readable red-and-white gable end, but the roof is a noisy jumble of dark plank steps, the cupola and hoist beam are lost in it, and the long sides are dark and blank, so it doesn't read as a gambrel barn.

log.summary: The gable-end front has the right barn pieces (X-braced doors, hoist beam, hay and fence), but the roof is a noisy jumble of grey stone with red patches showing through. It doesn't read as a gambrel and swamps the whole build.
